_comment: The two cross-cluster bridges of YYC AI's switch window (yyc-ai/refactor DESIGN 15.5, WP-60), as code: yyc-ai/infra/bridges.sh up|check|down reads this. Both live on ONE server, `server` below: a Debian box with no public IP in Hetzner project yyc, network yyc (10.0.0.0/16), carrying each bridge's address as a Hetzner alias IP, with HAProxy in TCP mode (Hetzner refused lb11 load balancers: the account's primary IP limit, 16, is full and stays so, Deyao 2026-11-05). Each service listens on its bridge's address at `listen` and goes round-robin to every target server's private IP at `nodePort`, a NodePort with externalTrafficPolicy Local; connections and health checks leave from the bridge's address, so the callee's NetworkPolicy admits that /32. Health check: TCP every `interval` s, `timeout` s, down after 1 + `retries` failures: a node without a ready callee pod fails it and gets no traffic. Targets: the servers matching the Hetzner label selector `targets` minus those matching `exclude` (servers that are no Kubernetes node), read from the Hetzner API on every `up`. callee names the pods behind the NodePort, on the targets' cluster: bridges.sh check expects every server that runs a ready one to be a healthy target. The box reaches the internet (packages) only through network yyc's route 0.0.0.0/0 -> yyc-nat1 (`gateway` 10.0.0.1 on its private interface, DNS `resolver`), and SSH only through `jump`. Cost: cax11 fsn1 EUR 5.99 net, EUR 7.188 gross a month (EUR 0.01152 gross an hour; Hetzner API /v1/server_types, 2026-11-05), no primary IP.
